title: ADR-0149: record that every dataset face answers declared members only — its "Leaves unchanged" line still names /analytics/dataset/query
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUg7BKfRBcTPyMxbLh

Filing gate ③: area-directed (area S2 of seat domain:server#5). Boundary flag of the L2 contract review 6908009392 on PR #34198 (card #34005): the code cites ADR-0149 for the closed-member rule, and the record carries no line for it.

## Today

ADR-0149 states the closed set for the AI tools (D2: the AI chooses from the governed catalogue) and lists `/analytics/dataset/query` and its gate chain under **Leaves unchanged**. The maintainer ruling 6902027136 on #34005 closed the REST dataset door too, and PR #34198 implements it at one point every dataset entry passes (`answerDataset`).

## Ask

Amend ADR-0149 with a dated correction: every dataset face (REST single and batch doors, `query_dataset`, the MCP bridges, the publish build probes) answers only the members the dataset declares, by the maintainer ruling of #34005; strike or qualify the `/analytics/dataset/query` entry under **Leaves unchanged**. Governed text: the ADR lane's usual review applies.

Blocked-by: #34198 (the record follows the code).

Reader: domain:spec (ADR). Size XS.
